## Tech workers

Draft fruit-KPIs for something you build — two indicators that would show your product growing peace, patience, or self-control in users, alongside one known-harm metric you commit to reducing. Audit your team against the four trustworthiness components (integrity, competency, accountability, education), then retro-cast: describe the fruit your product bears in five years if all goes *right*, and work backward to this quarter's decisions.
